messages:
Maya: Quick thread to lock down policy options for customer retention/pin requests. Sales got a request for a guaranteed 90-day pin + perf SLA for a translation model. Can we define product options?
Priya: We should offer a three-tier approach: free soft-pin (30d), Hosted-paid retention (90d) with a Reserved-Pool flag, and Dedicated retention with SLA credits.
Jon: Legal: need standard contract language and migration veto clauses (metric-based). We can't promise internals (quantization) but can promise metrics.
Ravi: Infra: reserving pools for Hosted customers fragments capacity. Need cost delta and a minimum commitment. Also recommend an "auto-unpin" safety after term unless customer renews.
Sam-CS: Customers expect rollback guarantees and an audit trail for model swaps. They'll want a 5-10 business day migration window and a 3-day rollback option.
ops-bot: Suggested bench gates: perf_score >= 0.78, quality_delta <= 2% on customer-critical prompts, embedding_similarity >= 0.95.
Priya: Proposed SLA example for Paid retention: p95 <= 350ms (512 tokens), 99.95% uptime, migration notice = 10 business days, 90d retention as paid add-on.
Maya: Launch gates suggestion: (1) bench suite pass, (2) infra cost model signed off, (3) legal addendum ready, (4) 2 customer canaries OR 1 customer + 1 internal canary.
Ravi: Action items: Eng -> capacity delta & canary infra (Ravi), Product -> pricing + spec (Priya/Maya), Legal -> addendum draft (Jon), CS -> traffic patterns & acceptance tests (Sam).
Maya: Timeline: bench spec + draft addendum in 5 business days. No hard pins enabled until telemetry/regression alerts are live.
Jon: I'll drop a short retention clause draft into contracts tracker and tag legal-review.
Sam-CS: I'll collect customer prompt samples and upload to /mnt/onboard/retention-samples.
Priya: Also adding a canary config template:
```
canary:
  mode: reserved
  duration_days: 14
  traffic_pct: 5
```
Ravi: We'll include auto-unpin + renewal workflow. If infra flags multiple concurrent requests, fallback to Dedicated-only offering.
Maya: Good progress. Quick sync Friday after cost numbers. Thanks everyone.
